title: E256-X0 proof-carrying compositional H4 safe-transition graph and path certificate

contract.digest_rule: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 bytes from the first byte of the unique start marker through the last byte of the unique end marker, inclusive

toolchain.arithmetic: exact integers only; floating point forbidden
toolchain.scope: host-side structural graph and certificate derivation; no RTL, synthesis, Metal, FHE, or physical hardware

algebraic_contract.closed_form: For selectors x,y,z, output column c depends on original-row-a columns c+x_a+y_b+z_k mod 8 for b,k in 0..3
algebraic_contract.literal_oracle: 32 singleton byte lanes, actual ordered row shifts, and all-nonzero AES MixColumns support for exactly three rounds
algebraic_contract.first_selector_invariance_scope: all 384 first selectors times all 256 ordered support-class pairs
algebraic_contract.translation_invariance_scope: all 8 translations times all 256 ordered support-class pairs

prior_census_contract.exploratory_disclosure_before_freeze: d=0 was the only stride with zero failed classes

full_graph: loop and off-diagonal directed edge counts
same-support and support-changing directed edge counts

required: exact lexicographically least Hamiltonian-cycle DP anchored at node 0

diagnostics_contract.walk_count: exact sum(A^k) over the full directed 384-node graph
diagnostics_contract.log2_bounds: integer floor and ceil from bit_length only

path_certificate_contract.primary_selection: first 12 quotient nodes of the lexicographically least anchored Hamiltonian cycle, each lifted to the lowest catalog index with that support
path_certificate_contract.fallback_selection: alternate the lexicographically first support-changing safe two-cycle to length 12; if absent, repeat the lowest safe loop
path_certificate_contract.verification: reconstruct graph/root; check index ranges and tuple-code equality; independently check all 11 adjacent graph transitions; trust no supplied edge witness
path_certificate_contract.scope: all eleven represented contiguous three-round windows satisfy structural all-to-all byte dependency only

controls.mutation: duplicate one offset inside a tuple
use bitwise XOR of support elements instead of modular addition
drop one element before sumset construction
decode destination bits most-significant-bit first within each byte
hash mutated graph bytes and present the matching forged root
set the first lexicographic unsafe edge
clear the first lexicographic safe edge
remove one ordered pair from the exhaustive algebraic corpus
replace one path tuple code without changing its index
insert the first lexicographic unsafe transition into the path
remove the required quotient Hamiltonian observation

receipt_contract.deterministic_digest_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical compact sorted-key JSON deterministic_payload
receipt_contract.record_hash_rule: SHA-256 of canonical complete record with record_sha256 set to null
receipt_contract.check_rule: regenerate and require byte-identical canonical deterministic_payload bytes and deterministic_payload_sha256

validity_rule: Exact frozen identities, complete algebraic scopes, exact prior-census reconstruction, canonical graph/root closure, all required diagnostics, a verified twelve-selector path with eleven safe transitions, and all 23 controls detected are mandatory. SCC and Hamiltonian outcomes are graded findings.
non_claims: no differential, linear, truncated, integral, algebraic, cube, related-key, cancellation, or value-feasibility claim
no security level, production round count, schedule, evolution rule, key derivation, XOF, suite, protocol, or standard
no architecture, storage organization, RTL enforcement, vendor FPGA, place-and-route, Fmax, physical power, side-channel, or fault claim
no Metal, encrypted Metal, FHE, or self-modifying-cipher execution claim
the fixed-selector wide_trail_manifest does not certify mixed walks
reviewed standard AEAD remains mandatory for real data
E256-063 remains OPEN; no C/H/N row or public claim epoch moves
